event.title: Algeria Wildfire
event.summary: Wildfires have ravaged villages in Jijel province, located nearly 350 kilometers east of Algiers, resulting in significant damage. Residents are currently assessing the impact as emergency crews work to restore electricity and clear affected areas. In response to the disaster, a national mourning has been declared.
